verdict.rationale: Apple documents concrete core counts (16-core CPU/40-core GPU, 546GB/s bandwidth) and a specific compile benchmark ("Up to 2.1x faster build performance when compiling code in Xcode"), and independent Geekbench comparisons on Hacker News corroborate strong multi-core performance ("It absolutely shits on my 13900K"). missing for 10: explicit documented boost clock/frequency behavior, broader independent multi-core benchmark corroboration beyond one HN thread, and real-world heavy parallel job case studies (e.g. large monorepo builds) rather than a single Xcode multiplier claim.
